name: Mom's Son
overview: Tema, a talented twenty-year-old student and the soul of the company, lives an ideal life, considering his mother Vika to be his best friend and support. However, sudden disturbing news ruins his world and forces him to rethink his relationship with his mother, in which overprotection has become a burden. Vika and Tema realize that they both need to grow up in order to figure out how to live on.
